تحتفرن (form VIII)
# تَحْتَفِرْنَ (taḥtafirna) /taħ.ta.fir.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# تُحْتَفَرْنَ (tuḥtafarna) /tuħ.ta.far.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
